neighbours.label: New Testament exegesis: Christ, Hebrews and Gospel citations in a commentary
fire: He is a high priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek (Hebrews 7:17).
How much more will the blood of Christ, who through the Spirit cleanses us.
Jesus wept at the tomb of Lazarus (John 11:35) with his friends.
Paul writes that Christ, who through suffering learned obedience, saves us.
He prayed in deep anguish (Luke 22:44) in the garden.
Christ entered heaven itself on our behalf (Hebrews 9:24), the writer says.
Jesus said to the Father, "Thy word is truth" (John 17:17) at supper.
The blood of Christ, who through death defeated sin, redeems us.
quiet: He is a head teacher for ever after the rules of the board (Report 7:17).
How much more will the price of oil, which through the summer rises.
The dog sat at the door of the house (Page 11) with his friends.
Paul writes that Mark, who through hard work got rich, helps us.
He spoke in deep anger (Section 22) in the garden.
Ann entered the office itself on our behalf (Note 9), the writer says.
Tom said to the clerk, "This price is wrong" (Page 17) at lunch.
The cost of oil, which through use goes down, helps us.

notes: Card: ' in' 6, ' the' 3, ' of' 2, ':' 2 in scripture commentary. Probes: ' through' after 'Christ, who' 0.67, ':' in Luke 22:41 0.52, ' the' 0.28, ':' in John 17 0.19; manager after the board 0.01. Near misses keep the sentence and citation shape with other topics.
